The Company may carry out complementary activities related to the financial, insurance, pension and capitalization markets, provided they do not conflict with its investment advisory activity, whether through the legal entity described above or through a third-party legal entity. All activities are performed with due segregation and in compliance with the rules of the CVM or other regulatory and self-regulatory bodies. k.k906815ae: Victoria, founding partner of Vectrum Capital
k.kf1a4e833: An economist and investment specialist, Victoria built her professional career in the high-net-worth space, combining technical knowledge with a deep understanding of the people behind each fortune.
k.k1461a2c6: Over the past five years, she worked in banking, directly managing and serving portfolios of high-net-worth clients, earning recognition for client satisfaction and service excellence. Her relationship with this segment, however, began long before: more than ten years of experience in and proximity to the high-net-worth and luxury markets, which gave her a deep familiarity with its codes and expectations and, above all, with the importance of trust in long-term wealth relationships.
k.k99f26358: An economist by training and C-Pro I certified by ANBIMA, Victoria believes that wealth should not be understood only through numbers, products or returns, but within the context of each client's life: their businesses, their family, their projects and the legacy they wish to build.
k.k8ec171bf: A Christian, wife and mother, she brings to Vectrum the values that also guide her life: responsibility, trust, excellence and a long-term view.
k.k754fcda9: Thiago, founding partner of Vectrum Capital
k.kd405bd6e: Investment Advisor  |  Postgraduate in Business Management  |  CFP® · ANCORD · PQO · C-Pro I
k.k0f4f132d: Seventeen years in financial markets, and an uncommon path to get here. Thiago is the firm's accredited Investment Advisor, and he began his career seeing the world through the logic of trade between nations, and today he sees families' lives through the logic of what must endure.
k.k592ae261: With a degree in International Trade and a postgraduate degree in Business Management, he carried from the start of his career a business mindset that has never left him: the habit of seeing risk, currency, cycles and context before looking at a product. It is an education that teaches you to read the world as a connected system, and that reading still shapes the way he builds a portfolio.
k.k5f212cc2: He holds a set of certifications rarely found together in one person. He is a CFP®, the most widely recognized international certification in personal finance, awarded in Brazil by Planejar. He is accredited by ANCORD as an Investment Advisor, holds the PQO from B3, the operational qualification required of those who work in the Brazilian capital markets, and the C-Pro I from ANBIMA, focused on portfolio construction and qualified technical advice.
k.k2876e227: His time at a multi-family office placed him inside a specific kind of conversation: that of families who have already solved the question of returns and have turned their attention to what comes after. Organization, predictability, continuity, succession. It is an environment where no one asks which fund performed best last quarter, but rather how the family's wealth will make it through the next decade intact.
k.k466068d9: It is from this experience that the perspective he brings to Vectrum is born: wealth is structure, not product. And structure is built with technique, but sustained by trust.

k.kefafad46: Investment Specialist  |  MBA in Capital Markets  |  C-Pro I
k.kc2dfd9ac: Nearly twenty years in financial markets, built inside some of the country's largest institutions. Fábio brings the experience of someone who has spent his entire career sitting beside the people who decide what to do with their own wealth.
k.k02c4c9f1: He spent nine years at Itaú Unibanco, the last of them as a senior investment specialist, after stints at Santander and Citibank. A career built at large banks, where one learns early that trust is not won with products; it is won with consistency.
k.kb3c3ef98: A graduate in Commercial Management, with an MBA in Economics with a focus on Capital Markets and C-Pro I certification from ANBIMA, he combines the commercial insight of someone who understands relationships with the technical command of someone who understands markets.

Being the father of a child on the autism spectrum taught him to see the long term as it truly is, made of patience, of protection and of decisions whose value only shows many years later. It is through this lens that he looks at each client's wealth.
k.kf2c398a0: The asset classes below are available on the XP platform. What makes sense for you depends on your profile, time horizon and goals, and that is decided at the table.
k.k1a8e4357: With fixed income, you lend money to a government, a bank or a company and receive it back with the return set at the time of investment. It can be fixed-rate, floating-rate, linked to the CDI or the Selic rate, or hybrid, with inflation plus a spread. Tesouro Direto, CDBs, LCIs, LCAs and debentures are examples.
k.k96254a74: There is the credit risk of the issuer, and selling before maturity may result in a price different from what was expected. Some securities are covered by the FGC (Brazil's deposit guarantee fund), within its limits.
k.k6dd49153: Buying a share means becoming a part owner of a publicly traded company listed on B3. Returns can come from share price appreciation and from profit distributions, such as dividends and interest on equity.
k.kad699ee6: This is variable income: prices change every day and may fall below the amount invested. Stocks are not covered by the FGC.
k.k35acec3f: A fund pools the money of many investors into a single portfolio, run by a professional manager and supervised by the CVM. There are fixed income, multi-strategy, equity and currency funds, each with its own investment policy.
k.k87a8b3a7: Funds charge fees, such as a management fee, and have their own redemption terms. The fact sheet and the fund regulations set out the rules for each one.
k.k1f139e5e: Real estate investment funds (FIIs) invest in properties, such as corporate office floors, logistics warehouses and shopping centers, or in real estate securities, such as CRIs. Units trade on the exchange and income is usually distributed periodically.
k.k46b46b21: Unit prices fluctuate in the market and income is not guaranteed: it depends on vacancy, defaults and the state of the sector.
k.k7a51f194: The Certificate of Structured Operations (COE) combines elements of fixed income and derivatives in a single product. It has a set term and return scenarios known from the outset, linked to a reference asset, such as an index or a currency.
k.k74f7b3d7: Depending on the structure, the capital may be protected or at risk. Redemption before maturity may not be available or may be below the amount invested. It is not covered by the FGC.
k.kfb22f66c: This is when a company or a fund issues new securities to raise capital in the market, as in a company's IPO or an issuance of debentures or fund units. Investors place a reservation during the offering period.
k.k2a3cbd1c: Each offering has its own prospectus, allocation rules and risks. Placing a reservation does not guarantee receiving the full amount requested.
k.k433e829e: Private pension plans are long-term investments designed for retirement and estate succession. A PGBL usually makes sense for those who file the full income tax return, and a VGBL for all other cases.
k.kfe7d13e5: The choice between the progressive and the regressive tax table changes the outcome and must be made carefully. Early withdrawals may incur more tax.
k.k8ecb16bd: Insurance protects what you have built against what cannot be foreseen. Life insurance guarantees a benefit to your beneficiaries, and property insurance covers assets such as real estate and vehicles.
k.kc783f80c: Each policy has its own coverage, exclusions and waiting periods. Insurance is issued by the insurer and distributed by XP.
k.k69b0e67c: Foreign exchange lets you send and receive funds from abroad, pay expenses outside the country and buy foreign currency, within the rules of the Central Bank of Brazil.
k.k3906c42b: Exchange rates change throughout the day, and transactions carry their own costs and taxes, such as IOF.
k.k67b2bc76: With collateralized credit, the investments you already hold serve as collateral for a loan. It is a way to access liquidity without having to unwind your portfolio.
k.kfc4dd4dd: If the value of the collateral falls, it may need to be topped up. Rates and terms depend on credit analysis.
k.k7b6145a5: Investing outside Brazil lets you hold part of your wealth in other currencies and markets, with access to foreign stocks, funds and bonds, either directly abroad or through products available here.
k.k009726c6: Beyond the fluctuation of the assets themselves, there is exchange rate risk, and taxation follows specific rules.
k.k9e148444: Futures contracts are agreements to buy or sell an asset, such as an index, the dollar or a commodity, on a future date at a price set today. They are used for protection, known as hedging, or for short-term trades.
k.k3662d312: They are leveraged derivatives: losses may exceed the amount deposited as margin. They require a compatible investor profile.
